Body: Welcome to Northbay.

We're a small crew of people who spend a lot of time on trail. We build gear around what actually works out there — not what looks good on a spec sheet. No fluff, no overreach. Just things worth carrying.

You're here because you've been paying attention, and we appreciate that.

Now, to the socks.

The Trailwool Sock (NB-SOK-11) is a merino wool blend sock that comes three pairs to a pack. That's the whole pitch, really — but here's what it means on your trip:

Merino wool manages moisture and odor across multi-day use better than synthetic alternatives. It doesn't feel wet when it's damp. That matters on day three.

Three pairs per pack means you're not doing sock math before a trip. One pack covers a standard long weekend or a solid week of day hikes with rotation.

These are not waterproof socks. They're not insulated for winter mountaineering. They're a well-made trail sock for three-season use — the kind you reach for without thinking.

Pick up a 3-pack and see how they hold up on your next one.
